# Container Architect Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills

## Overview

Use when designing containerization strategy including Dockerfiles, Kubernetes manifests, resource limits, and scaling policies.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [container-architect-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
container-architect-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@container-architect` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Provision and configure cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP
- Validate infrastructure-as-code templates for security and compliance
- Execute capacity planning based on workload patterns and growth projections
- Configure auto-scaling policies with appropriate thresholds and cooldowns

## Industry Standards Applied

- **Well-Architected Framework**: Cloud architecture pillars: security, reliability, performance, cost, operations
- **12-Factor App**: Methodology for building cloud-native, scalable services
- **CIS Benchmarks**: Security configuration baselines for cloud platforms
